_comment: Release notes per versionName. Shown in the app's What's new popup (WhatsNew.kt) and used as the GitHub release notes by the githubRelease Gradle task. Newest version first. icon: favorite, share, navbar, chart, timer, weight, workout, calendar, home, settings, backup, update, bug, speed, star.

3.5.0.title: Rest timer
3.5.0.text: Tap the ring after a set to start your rest. It counts down, then counts up in your accent colour to show any extra rest. The ring stays full until your next tap.

3.5.0.title: Beep in your headphones
3.5.0.text: When the rest is up you get a buzz and a beep in your headphones, even with the screen off. Pick the sound in Settings → Timer.

3.5.0.title: Live heart rate graph
3.5.0.text: The last 10 minutes of heart rate show inside the ring, with your BPM just below it.

3.5.0.title: Countdown in the notification
3.5.0.text: See your rest countdown and total time without opening the app.

3.5.0.title: Accent from your music
3.5.0.text: Tap Auto next to Accent Color and the app takes the colour of the album art playing in Spotify.

3.5.0.title: Save sessions as files
3.5.0.text: Save a session's .tcx file straight to a folder on your phone, or share it as before.

3.5.0.title: Smaller things
3.5.0.text: Stats is the first tab, Back closes the search, copy and duplicate have clearer icons, and the rest time no longer resets when you reopen the app.

3.4.0.title: App icon
3.4.0.text: Pick your launcher icon in Settings → Appearance: a 25, 20, 15 or 10 kg plate in its standard colour.

3.4.0.title: Bigger icon
3.4.0.text: The plate now fills the whole icon, with no background behind it.

3.2.0.title: Exercise history
3.2.0.text: In Stats, expand an exercise and tap Full history: every set you've logged, your best estimated 1RM and heaviest set, and a 1RM trend.

3.2.0.title: One-rep max calculator
3.2.0.text: New in Tools: enter a weight and reps, or tap one of your exercises, for your estimated 1RM and a percentage table for working sets.

3.2.0.title: Plate calculator
3.2.0.text: New in Tools: the plates for each side of the bar for any target weight, with your bar and biggest plate size.

3.1.0.title: Stats and Sessions tabs
3.1.0.text: Workout Stats and Sessions have their own tabs and swipe pages. The navbar scrolls sideways and keeps the current tab in the middle.

3.1.0.title: Straight to your session
3.1.0.text: Saving a timer session takes you to Sessions, where you can see its heart rate graph or export it.

3.1.0.title: More timed exercises
3.1.0.text: Treadmill, Running, Walking, Cycling, Rowing, Yoga, Sauna and their Finnish names log as minutes. Side plank, Wall sit and Dead hang log as sets × hold time.

3.1.0.title: Contact support
3.1.0.text: Now opens a GitHub issue with your app and Android version filled in.

3.0.0.title: Heart rate
3.0.0.text: Connect a Bluetooth strap from the heart under the timer. Live BPM while you train, and every timed session saves its heart rate graph.

3.0.0.title: Export to Strava
3.0.0.text: Share icon in Sessions exports a .tcx file with time and heart rate. Upload it at strava.com/upload.

3.0.0.title: New navbar
3.0.0.text: Always visible, text labels only. While the timer runs, the Timer tab shows the time.

3.0.0.title: Weight chart
3.0.0.text: Pinch to zoom from 1 to 10 weeks, and a whole-kilo axis fitted to your weigh-ins.

3.0.0.title: Smaller app
3.0.0.text: The download is now about 4 MB instead of 19 MB.
